verifications.claim: In the 2025-2026 NBA season, the Los Angeles Lakers and Houston Rockets are top-4 Western Conference teams.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The Lakers and Rockets are the No. 3 and 4 seeds in the West.'; R3: Western standings '3 Lakers 47 26 .644; ... 6 Rockets 43 29 .597'
verifications.reasoning: R2 supports both as top-4 at March 16, but R3 standings show Lakers 3rd and Rockets 6th later in season, creating contradiction.

verifications.reasoning: Records match for March 16 game, but no game on March 17 and games are 16th & 18th (not consecutive back-to-back), contradicting specific dates.
